_comment: Client groupings, shown in the frame browser under Client groupings. Add one by pasting the object from a designer's Share with team file into the list. Codes match library frame codes. An optional "client" nests the grouping under that client's row (Ford > Standard, Floater, Shadowbox).

groupings.name: Standard
groupings.note: For framed prints or paper work with glass. From Ford's Frame Specifications page.

groupings.name: Floater
groupings.note: For wrapped canvases and other mediums without glass. From Ford's Frame Specifications page.

groupings.name: Shadowbox
groupings.note: Extra deep frames for dimensional artwork, glass or raised prints. From Ford's Frame Specifications page.
